title: Undead (Watcher)

{{Infobox/Dungeon enemy |mob_type = *{{mt|Undead}} |spawn_condition = [[The Catacombs]] |mob_level = 70-374 |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 14,000-6,000,000 (Base) |defense = 550-2,000 |damage = 1,440-97,200 }} |id = WATCHER_SUMMON_UNDEAD_#, MASTER_WATCHER_SUMMON_UNDEAD_# }} '''Undeads''' are a series of [[Dungeon Mobs]] that can be summoned by [[The Watcher]] in [[The Catacombs]]. They take on different appearances and names, including {{MobSprite|Mr. Dead|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Revoker|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Tear|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Skull|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Walker|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Cannibal|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Frost|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Putrid|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Reaper|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Vader|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Flamer|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Freak|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Leech|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Mute|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Ooze|nolink=yes}}, {{MobSprite|Parasite|nolink=yes}}, and {{MobSprite|Psycho|nolink=yes}}. They can also appear as {{MobSprite|Wandering Soul|nolink=yes}}s. == Spawning == '''Undeads''' are repeatedly spawned from [[The Watcher]] in the [[Blood Room]] in [[The Catacombs]] and above. The amount spawned increases with higher floors, starting at {{Green|9}} in [[Entrance]] and increasing by {{Green|1}} with each floor. {{Cite Discord |staff=yes |url=https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1557142756562837517 |user=mrkeith |text= 
another dungeons related question, how many watcher undeads get spawned from the watcher?
{{Code|9 + (floorTier)}} it appears, code is quite branching}} == Behavior == '''Undeads''' will run towards nearby players to attack them with melee. In [[The Catacombs - Floor II]], some of them also have special behavior. == Variants == Throughout [[The Watcher]]'s fight, multiple random Undeads will be spawned. Each version has the same base [[Stats]] and loot, but has a different name and skin. Multiple of the same type can exist. Each undead can also spawn with random armor pieces. In [[The Catacombs - Floor II]] and above, special behaviors are added, as listed below. In [[The Catacombs - Floor V]] and above, they can have additional modifiers, as listed further down. {| class="wikitable" !Head !Name !Abilities in Floor II+ |- |[[File:Mr. Dead Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Mr. Dead |Gains Strength for every Undead near it.{{Confirm}} |- |[[File:Revoker Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Revoker |Can charge towards the player.{{Confirm}} |- |[[File:Tear Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Tear |Has a Bleeding effect much like the [[Minotaur]].{{Confirm}} |- |[[File:Skull Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Skull |Can throw a bone like Crypt Lurkers every 12 seconds.{{Confirm}} |- |[[File:Walker Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Walker |Faster than other Undeads.{{Confirm}} |- |[[File:Cannibal Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Cannibal |Targets [[Berserker]]s |- |[[File:Frost Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Frost |Targets [[Mage]]s |- |[[File:Putrid Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Putrid |Targets [[Healer]]s |- |[[File:Reaper Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Reaper |Targets [[Archer]]s |- |[[File:Vader Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Vader |Targets [[Tank]]s |- |[[File:Flamer Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Flamer |Explodes when killed, dealing 1% of nearby players' max {{Stat|hp}}. |- |[[File:Freak Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Freak |Deals {{Stat|Damage|1.2x}}. |- |[[File:Leech Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Leech |Heals for 2% of its max {{Stat|hp}} every second. |- |[[File:Mute Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Mute |Prevents the player from hearing certain in-game sounds for 5 seconds. |- |[[File:Ooze Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Ooze |Has {{Stat|Health|1.25x}}. |- |[[File:Parasite Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Parasite |Spawns 3 {{MobSprite|Parasite (Silverfish);Parasites}} when killed. |- |[[File:Psycho Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Psycho |Has a 1/3 chance of teleporting behind the player when attacked. |- |[[File:Steve Sprite.png|center|25px]] |Wandering Soul |Wandering Souls take the appearance of players who die in a Dungeon run. Floor II]] and above, the {{MobSprite|Ooze|nolink=yes}} undead has {{Stat|Health|1.25x}}, and the {{MobSprite|Freak|nolink=yes}} undead has {{Stat|Damage|1.2x}}. Then, in [[The Catacombs - Floor V]] and above, there is a chance for each undead summoned by [[The Watcher]] to have one of the following modifiers. When one is chosen, all undeads summoned spawn with it. {|class="wikitable" ! Modifier ! Description |- | {{Green|Healthy}} | Grants {{Stat|Health|1.3x}}, a {{Chance|5%|1|20|kills}} chance to drop a {{Item|Healing Tissue}}, and a {{Chance|0.4%|1|250}} chance to drop a {{Item|Vitamin Death}}. |- | {{Dark Blue|Stormy}} | Grants a {{Chance|1%|1|100|kills}} chance to drop {{Ench|Thunderlord VI}} on death. Every {{Green|5 seconds}}, there is also a {{Chance|33.3%|1|3}} chance to strike lightning to all players in a {{Green|6}} block radius. This deals {{Stat|Damage|2,000|icononly=yes}}/{{Stat|Damage|2,500|icononly=yes}}/{{Stat|Damage|5,000|icononly=yes}} in F5-F7 respectively, and {{Stat|Damage|45,000|icononly=yes}}/{{Stat|Damage|60,000|icononly=yes}}/{{Stat|Damage|70,000|icononly=yes}} in M5-M7 respectively. |- | {{Color|gold|Golden}} | Grants full {{Item|Golden Armor}} and drop {{Item|Gold Essence|1}} on death. |- | {{Aqua|Speedy}} | Grants increased {{Stat|Speed}} and drops {{Item|Dungeon Potion}}s of the equivalent [[Catacombs#Floors|floor]] tier. |- | {{Gray|Stealthy}} | Makes the mobs invisible, except for their name tags and armor. |- | {{Red|Boomer}} | Makes the mobs wear {{Item|TNT|link=}} on their head, which is triggered when they die. After a few second it explodes in a {{Green|5x5}} radius, dealing {{Red|100%}} of the player's {{Stat|Health}} as {{Stat|True Damage}}. This can be mitigated with {{Stat|Absorption}} and the {{Item|Wither Cloak Sword}}. This also drops {{Item|Superboom TNT}}. |} At the end, on all floors, each '''Undead''' has their {{Stat|Health}} randomized by an amount between {{Stat|Health|-2,000|icononly=yes}} and {{Stat|Health|6,000}} based on the following formula: {\color{red}\text{Max Health} = \text{Health} + \left(1000 \times \operatorname{rand}(-2, 6)\right)}{{Cite Discord |url = https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1554513093805998123 |staff = y |user = mrkeith |date = September 29, 2026, 11:20 AM (EST) |text =
